overview: This enum selects which help pages the game shows when a tutorial window opens.

None.simple: An empty topic that selects no help page.
None.technical: Declared as the zero value of the uint8 enum and used as the row default in FGameDataTableRow_TutorialWidget. ShowTutorialTypes compares cached rows against the requested type with exact equality. No exported TutorialWidgetDataTable row carries this type, so no source consumer requests it and the default alone has no observable page set.

Move.simple: The help page that explains how to move the character.
Move.technical: Declared as uint8 slot 1. UGameConfigTutorialWidget binds the matching TUT_INGAME label to this id, and OnTutorialDecided casts the byte to EGameTutorialWidgetType and calls ShowTutorial. The in-battle tutorial builder also stores the same value in FStudioBattleTutorialInputStep::Inputs, which GameBattleStoryStates forwards to ShowTutorialTypes. That function scans cached TutorialWidgetDataTable rows and appends exact type matches in list order.

Invalid.simple: A reserved invalid marker for tutorial topics.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. No source consumer in this checkout compares a tutorial type with Invalid and no exported row carries it, so its runtime behavior is unresolved.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_TutorialWidget defaults TutorialWidgetType to None, and every exported row uses one of the 38 named non-None values. No exported row uses Invalid.

UGameTutorialWidget::ShowTutorial forwards one type to ShowTutorialTypes. ShowTutorialTypes accepts an ordered list and concatenates the matching rows for each requested type before loading textures and showing page zero.
The in-battle Gojo tutorial stores these values as numeric casts in FStudioBattleTutorialInputStep::Inputs, and GameBattleStoryStates passes that list straight to ShowTutorialTypes.
The config tutorial and config help screens store the id as a uint8 payload, so their call sites reach the enum through a cast in OnTutorialDecided.
Several types contribute more than one page, so one ShowTutorial call can open a multi-page tutorial window.
